name: Matt Bettinelli-Olpin
biography: Matt Bettinelli-Olpin is an American filmmaker, writer, producer, musician, and actor best known as a founding member of the filmmaking collective Radio Silence. He first gained recognition in the found footage genre through Radio Silence’s segment “10/31/98” in V/H/S and later co-directed horror films including Devil's Due, Southbound, and Ready or Not. Bettinelli-Olpin later helped revive the Scream franchise with Scream and Scream VI, followed by the vampire horror film Abigail.
